items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He was crazy about Hawk. 'Who was the greatest?' And he'd talk about the greatness... He was his idol. He worshipped...idolized...

ctx.x: David Jones, yeah. A fantastic musician. He's the man that when he went to New York with the Missourians... He went to St. Louis, he joined R.Q. Dixon and them in Missouri, and he went to New York. And he was a terrific tenor saxophone player. He played legato. See, Hawk and them people in New York was playing staccato and slap tonguing. That would have been ...(?)... And they heard David Jones, and they all come to play legato.
